title: owo-lib issue #405: NeoForge 1.21.1 - Crash with Accessories and owo-lib
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by muggleorwizard]
Install Accessories via curseforge, owo-lib will automatically install as a dependency. Load game, open world or create new world, game will crash when loading reaches 100%
Crash error is: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: net/fabricmc/fabric/api/networking/v1/PlayerLookup
Game crashes with owo-lib 0.12.15.1-beta.6+1.21 (latest version for NeoForge 1.21.1). Does not crash with owo-lib 0.12.15.1-beta.3+1.21 (previous version)
Latest.log: https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/5FHQNvc 
Debug.log: https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/gMpJdRU
Crash Report: https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/IpGDGyo

https://github.com/wisp-forest/accessories/issues/301

[comment by Dragon-Seeker (member)]
Consequence of changes within owo neo that was to remove the FFAPI dependency, such should prevent future issues with avoiding using FFAPI due to numerous issues unresolved on there end.

[comment by uhloin (none)]
And what to do? Use beta.3?

[comment by muggleorwizard (none)]
> And what to do? Use beta.3?

newest update of accessories fixes the issue, just update and you will be fine

[comment by uhloin (none)]
I already had newest Accessories. It was not enough. I installed Forgified Fabric API, now OK
